description: What the MIX-FPGA macOS (Apple silicon) toolchain consists of, who owns each part, and how it is verified. Nothing is packaged or released from this file yet.

components.name: GHDL
components.provenance: Copied byte-for-byte from the validated NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 (darwin-arm64) into toolchains/experimental/ghdl-6.0.0; the original is untouched. Source offer required on redistribution.

components.name: Yosys
components.role: RTL Schematic (read GHDL netlist, proc, write JSON); no synthesis or place and route
components.source: https://github.com/YosysHQ/yosys (build 0.63+173 via YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite 2026-09-15)
components.provenance: Copied from NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 (libexec/yosys plus the five dylibs it loads and the Tcl 8.6 library) into toolchains/experimental/yosys-0.63.

components.name: Lima
components.role: Hidden Linux VM host for the Quartus implementation engine
components.provenance: Official release lima-2.2.1-Darwin-arm64.tar.gz (sha256 9e9eacce88f37e185c346bad73aa6136f738d8cdf8c3bb23cd42b071824bc66e, verified against the official SHA256SUMS).

components.name: openFPGALoader
components.license: Apache-2.0 (libusb and libftdi are LGPL; hidapi, zlib, zstd notices still to be added before redistribution)
components.source: https://github.com/trabucayre/openFPGALoader (build via YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite 2026-09-15, source revision 451beadf)
components.provenance: Copied byte-for-byte from NexysVHDL Toolchain 1.0 into toolchains/experimental/openfpgaloader-1.1.1; the original is untouched.

components.name: MIX-FPGA adapters and scripts
components.role: Board profiles, providers, VM provisioning scripts (platform/macos/lima)

components.name: Rosetta 2
components.role: Runs the x86-64 Quartus tools inside the Linux VM
components.install: One-time, by the student: softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license (Apple license, administrator password)

components.name: Quartus Prime Lite Edition
components.install: Supplied by the student from Altera's official download page after accepting the Altera license; installed headless inside the VM. Not redistributed by MIX-FPGA.

components.name: MAX 10 device support
components.install: Supplied by the student (max10-25.1std.0.1129.qdz) together with Quartus. Not redistributed by MIX-FPGA.
